reviews.text: This was great for our little doggo because he doesn't like the bigger dogs.  They understood this and had a small doggo section and he made 2 new friends.  Highly recommend.

Staff here really love dogs and care about their well being. My dog can be very anxious pittie as well as awkward around other dogs. She just spent a week at bow wow for boarding. During her stay, they were so patient and and tried different strategies to build her confidence in group play. For example they tried starting her day in 1-1 play before taking her to group. This seemed to work really well for her and by the end of the week she could even go to group earlier in the day. This is evident of the care the staff put into supporting her. I purchased puppy postcards while away and the updates were honest, fun and thorough with lots of pictures. It is a relief to know my dog is in good care at bow wow daycare or boarding. Very impressed
Great place and our pup loves going!
Always good energy

Everyone there has been very kind and helpful when caring for my energetic dog. They helped come up with some ideas and solutions to make him for comfortable. Also has great experiences with grooming. Would definitely recommend!
Very professional, efficient, quick and extremely reasonable pricing.I paid a lot more for worse cuts

The staff at the Bow Wow Lounge are so professional, kind and caring in their attention to our dog Canela when she stays there! She loves both the day care and the boarding, she always comes home happy and healthy. I can relax when I know our girl is under care of the Bow Wow Lounge!
The best folks take care of my pups! Best groomers too!
Thank you so much Mark! We look forward to seeing you again soon at Bow Wow Lounge.
Extremely friendly staff with great communication! Always takes care of my pup, wouldn’t go elsewhere

Better options available. Hopefully bow wow doesn’t make an error and then threaten to send you to collections.

Unprofessional/uninformed  person working that day lost a customer when they could have just admitted their mistake.

Asking for tips is also tacky. Just tack it onto the service.

Isla just had her second grooming at Bow Wow Lounge and she looks amazing! Clean, stylish, and exactly what I was hoping for—I asked for a Westie cut and they nailed it. We’ve loved Bow Wow Lounge for daycare for a while, and now we love them for grooming too. Highly recommend 😊
We've taken our pets here when we're out of town at least 5-10 times now and our pups always come back clean after their exit bath, tired from playing, and happy.
Our dog loves going to Bow Wow. Staff are caring and friendly
They’ve been so great with our sensitive stomach puppy, I’d recommend them to anyone looking for doggie daycare on the North Side
We appreciate the 5 star review Tyler! Thank you for sharing Lia & Ava with us! The staff at Bow Wow Lounge loves spending time with them. See you soon!

I couldn’t be happier with Bow Wow Lounge. The staff is incredibly friendly and clearly loves animals. They took great care of Sadie, keeping me updated and making sure my pet felt comfortable and safe. The facility is clean, well-organized, and welcoming. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for trustworthy and compassionate pet care.

Our boy Rex loves Bow Wow Lounge and so do we! Hilary, Brie, Liv, and all the amazing handlers at Bow Wow make this place exceptional.  Rex does daycare and boarding at Bow Wow fairly regularly and we have never had a single negative experience.  Communication is spot on, professional, and I know that Rex is in good hands.
We love Bow Wow!  They always take such good care of Atlas when we board him!
These folks are an extended and important part of our family now. Our pup loves them!
Been taking my dog here for 5 years and I most say this is by far the best day care in the area . Totally recommend

Have used for daycare and grooming. Good prices and our dog loves it here.

Highly recommend

As our Leo entered "adolescence," he started behaving like a whiny teenager. But the whole team at Bow Wow DID NOT GIVE UP ON HIM. They made some accommodations to help him get his behavior back on track. He learned that not all the staff are there just for him : )
The desk staff is OUTSTANDING, Rachel, Reenie, and Hilary. Truly, the first impressions of these women set the tone of professionalism, love, and security. You feel in your bones your pooch is in good hands. AND, Leo met the Love of his life there, Lola.....so......he will keep coming back!
Do not hesitate, join the BOW WOW LOUNGE FAMILY.
We love BowWow and so does our pup! They are great at communicating and she’s always happy when we pick her up. Great peace of mind when we travel.
Brooke took amazing care of my dog, Ali. He’s a boxer and can be a handful, but he fit right in and loved his time there!
My dog loves it here! The reservation process is simple, and I know he is in good hands during his play times and boarding.

When your dog PULLS you to the front door you know you found a great place.
When your dog is excited to see the staff you know you found a great place.
As the hoomans we couldn’t be happier!

A telephone conversation was my first encounter with Bow Wow. The counselor was informative, good-humored and helpful. I especially was relieved that I didn't have to "join a club" in order to get my dog groomed. When we arrived for his appointment, the staff were welcoming, and the groomer came out to meet us almost immediately. The latter was important, as my dog was very anxious about being in a strange environment. Tamara's gentle and expert nature put me at ease. Buddy relaxed a bit, and went with her without protest. Best of all, Tamara did an excellent job of grooming him. I made another appointment on the spot. I plan to be a regular client.

My dog Elliott loves coming here. He always has a blast in daycare with his human friends and his dog friends. I appreciate the honesty and realistic updates with the puppy postcards. The groomer Tamara is also great, and always leaves him smelling and looking FRESH!!!

The lobby is so cute and stylish! Plus they always have the newest toys and treats from our favorite brands.
Me and my sweet baby angel and I love Bow wow Lounge. The people here are so loving of our animals and treat them as their own. Thank you to all the great staff here!

I’ve been with Bow Wow Lounge for 3 years now. They have been so so great to our dogs. They both love coming in and seeing their human and dog friends.

Would highly recommend Bow Wow for boarding and daycare.

We’ve been going to bow wow for almost a year now and we love it! Our dog has an absolute blast and the staff are so kind, caring and such genuine people. We can’t imagine going anywhere else! We love bow wow! ❤️

We're so glad that Bow Wow is nearby for our big boy,  Tank.  He's a little anxious and has some medical needs,  but we have absolute peace of mind leaving him in the capable (and fun) hands of the Bow Wow staff.  He always has a great time at daycare or boarding and he really loves the staff.  Clean and intentionally facilities and friendly and very capable staff.  (They offer photo sessions throughout the year- one attached).

Bow Wow is my dog Merlin’s favorite place on the planet! He gets so excited when he senses we’re going to “school” and he’s been coming in for over a year now. Rachel and Hillary are the kindest and always very welcoming when we walk in the door. All of the staff are exceptional and Merl loves getting attention from them in addition to being able to run around and play with other pups. I do the postcard add-on and they bring me so much joy to see pics of him playing and the cute write up from his perspective!  I also love the seasonal add-on’s like the pics with Santa or Valentines magnet. Everything is always crafted with love and care. Really can’t praise this place enough. Thank you Bow Wow!

Mitchell loves going to daycare at Bow Wow. He just lights up when he sees the handlers come to get him. He comes home happy and tired, especially on days when his best dog friend Eddie is there to play with. A tired dog is a happy dog! I’ve never boarded a dog anywhere before but am going to give it a whirl.
Our dog Murphy loves daycare! He’s always so excited and runs through the door to greet his favorite people. This is a great place for boarding and daycare for your pup!
My dog loves it here! They take great care of her

Incredible people working here. Made me as a newcomer feel right at home, and treated my dog with thoughtful care while I was away. Love the report cards and all the cute services they offer while your pet is being boarded ❤️

I wish there was an option to add more stars. BWL is incredible. They are a 2nd home, a 2nd family to my dog, Orfie (which I appreciate as a working, single dog-human). They let Orfie be Orfie in his playtime and they are very attuned to any health and behavioral issues that come up. Everyone who works there, whether at the desk or handling the dogs, is super friendly. I would encourage any dog humans to check out BWL, and for those who do not have dogs, I would encourage them to get one, just for the BWL experience.
My dog gets the best care here. Everyone knows her and gives her lots of love and affection.
That staff are amazing!! They clearly love the dogs they work with and want to make sure everyone is happy!

I'm so happy that I'm able to take Gracie to Bow Wow. She has some anxiety and I never worry about her there. I know she's in good hands! Her anxiety usually disappears once she's there and if she's feeling a little anxious on any given day, they keep an eye on her to alert me that she may need some extra one-on-one time.

From the front desk to the handlers, I love that Gracie gets to go play with her friends with this crew running the show.

100% Phoebe approved! Simply the best. My dog loves their daycare, and I love that she can blow off some steam with a game of “ball!”  Their grooming salon does a terrific job, and I feel comfortable that my dog is safe and well cared for when we’ve used their boarding services. Every staff member loves what they do and the pets they care for and it shows.

This is such a wonderful place to take your dog for daycare and boarding. The staff are so friendly, and it feels like you're a part of their family. My Aussie loves going here, even after having some pretty bad separation anxiety. He was nervous for the first few trips, and now he runs toward the door when we get close. Highly recommend Bow Wow Lounge!

Bow Wow is a great place to send your dog! The staff really cares about and for them as if they were their own, and tries to make each dog‘s time there fun and enjoyable. Their retail is updated with cute seasonal stuff throughout the year too! My family’s anxious little dog has boarded there a few times and I know he’s in good hands :)

Great place to let your dog socialize and give you peace of mind.
I absolutely love the staff at Bow Wow Lounge. I have seen marked improvement in my dog's socializing and overall temperament when he attends. I enjoy knowing he's getting his doggy time in a safe and positive environment.

Everyone at BowWow is a dog lover and whisperer. They care deeply about every four-legged pup that trots through the door. My dog Mabel is so happy to attend daycare there, so much so she walks right through the door and up to the handler …
Very friendly and clearly dog-lovers!
